headline: 敘利亞阿薩德缺席判死刑
context: 敘利亞法院將已被推翻的前總統阿薩德（Bashar al-Assad）判處死刑，缺席審理。同案還有他的弟弟馬希爾・阿薩德（Maher al-Assad）與堂弟阿提夫・納吉布（Atef Najib），罪名是危害人類罪與戰爭罪。判決涵蓋敘利亞長達14年的內戰，這場戰爭造成約50萬人死亡。

sources.name: NPR
sources.summary: A Syrian court sentenced Assad along with his brother to death in absentia for crimes against humanity and war crimes during Syria's 14-year conflict that left about half a million people dead.
sources.title: Former Syrian President Assad sentenced to death in absentia

sources.name: BBC
sources.summary: The ex-president is convicted of committing war crimes and crimes against humanity during the country's civil war.
sources.title: Ousted Syrian dictator Bashar al-Assad sentenced to death in absentia

sources.name: Al Jazeera
sources.summary: Syria’s ex-president Bashar al-Assad, his brother Maher al-Assad and cousin Atef Najib have been sentenced to death
sources.title: Syrian court sentences Bashar al-Assad and Atef Najib to death

thread_text:
敘利亞法院判處被推翻的前總統阿薩德（Bashar al-Assad）死刑，缺席審理。

同案被判死刑的還有他弟弟馬希爾・阿薩德（Maher al-Assad）與堂弟阿提夫・納吉布（Atef Najib），罪名是危害人類罪與戰爭罪。判決涵蓋敘利亞長達14年的內戰，這場戰爭造成約50萬人死亡。

—— 本則整理自 NPR、BBC、半島電視台於 2026 年 8 月 11、12 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

voice_text: 敘利亞前總統阿薩德，被判處死刑，缺席審理。同案被判死刑的，還有他的弟弟和堂弟，罪名是危害人類罪與戰爭罪。這起判決，對應的是敘利亞長達十四年的內戰——那場戰爭造成大約五十萬人死亡。
